name: Vampiric Predator
body:
Vampiric predators are those who recognize the power and efficiency possessed by the most notorious creatures of the night, learning to fight and hunt in a similar fashion.

Class Features
Parasitic Strike (Su)

A vampiric predator learns to transfer the bloodshed of their enemies into vitality for themselves. Whenever a vampiric predator deals weapon damage to a flanked or flat-footed opponent they gain a number of temporary hit points equal to twice their class level. These temporary hit points last for a number of rounds equal to the vampiric predator’s Constitution modifier. The vampiric predator can benefit from only one set of temporary hit points from this ability; additional attacks end the previous effect and restart the duration. This ability replaces the combat tactics at 1st level.

Terrible Visage (Su)

Vampiric predators learn to emulate the undead creatures they are often compared to. These abilities replace the legendary slayer’s proficiency in medium armor, the bonus feat gained at 7th level and the slayer talents gained at 4th and 12th levels.

Shadowed Self: At 1st level, a vampiric predator gains additional benefit from concealment. When under the effects of any concealment a vampiric predator increases the mischance granted by 5%. This mischance increases by an additional 5% at 5th, 10th, 15, and 20th levels to a maximum of an additional 25%.

Frightening Mein: At 4th level, as a standard action, a vampiric predator can change their appearance to that of a more feral version of themselves. Upon doing so, all enemies within 30 ft must make a Will save with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 their legendary slayer level + their Charisma modifier or become shaken for 2d4 rounds. Enemies who successfully save against this ability cannot be affected for 24 hours. The transformation lasts for a number of minutes equal to the vampiric predator’s Constitution modifier. Ending this transformation early is a standard action and the vampiric predator must wait at least one minute before entering this form again. At 8th level when assuming this form, the vampiric predator also gains scent and may activate claws of night as a free action. The vampiric predator may use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + their constitution modifier. Claws of the Night: At 7th level, as a move action, a vampiric predator can manifest vicious claws with which to tear through their enemies. These claws deal 1d6 damage and are considered primary natural weapons. Initially these weapons are considered magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 10th level these claws deal 1d8 damage and are also treated as silver and cold iron. At 13th level, they deal 2d6 damage and at 16th level they deal 2d8 damage and count as adamantine. These claws last for a number of minutes equal to the vampiric predator’s constitution modifier, after which the ability can be activated again. Pursuit Predator: At 12th level, a vampiric predator gains the ability to shadow jump as the shadowdancer ability of the same name. This ability allows the vampiric predator to teleport up to 100 ft per class level through shadows per day. This ability may be used any number of times per day but must be used in 10ft increments.

Delayed Tactics (Ex)

A vampiric predator gains the combat tactics ability at 5th level rather than 1st level and gains the bonuses and extras of the combat tactics employed as a legendary slayer of 4 levels lower. The vampiric predator also does not get their second combat tactic until 13th level and their 3rd at 19th. They do not gain a 4th consecutive combat tactic.
